//go:build integration

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	studentclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/student"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	planningmessages "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/message/nats"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/hybridreplan"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// Root launches isolated providers and applies owner migrations. The first
// event is genuine registered Student evidence -> mastery/outbox -> production
// Student relay. Additional events are explicitly named transport fixtures for
// burst/lost-ACK tests. They never pretend to be additional learner evidence.
// Every snapshot read/checkpoint uses actual Student HTTP and actual Planner PG.
func TestT202ActualHybridTriggerAndSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("T202_ACTUAL_HYBRID") != "true" {
		t.Skip("root-owned actual T20.2 gate absent")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("PLANNER_T202_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil || (!infraAcceptanceDatabase(t, cfg, "planner") && (cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_planner_integration_proof")) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact isolated Planner PG required")
	}
	var owner struct {
		URL         string                   `json:"url"`
		Token       string                   `json:"token"`
		StudentID   string                   `json:"student_id"`
		PathID      string                   `json:"path_id"`
		Targets     []domain.HybridTargetRef `json:"targets"`
		SnapshotRef string                   `json:"snapshot_ref"`
		EventID     string                   `json:"event_id"`
	}
	t202ReadJSON(t, os.Getenv("T202_OWNER_READY_FILE"), &owner)
	address, e := url.Parse(owner.URL)
	if e != nil || address.Scheme != "http" || address.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || address.User != nil || address.Path != "" || owner.Token == "" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: dedicated loopback Student owner required")
	}
	natsURL := os.Getenv("T202_NATS_URL")
	broker, e := url.Parse(natsURL)
	if e != nil || (!infraAcceptanceNATS(t, natsURL) && (broker.Scheme != "nats" || broker.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || broker.Port() != "59000")) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: isolated actual broker required")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("T202_OWNER_EVENT_FILE"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: committed owner event file required")
	}
	official, err := domain.DecodePlanningStateChangedEvent(raw)
	if err != nil || official.StudentID != owner.StudentID || official.Data.LearningPathID != owner.PathID || official.EventID != owner.EventID {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: original committed owner envelope mismatch")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 150*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if err = pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: Planner PG unavailable")
	}
	infraAcceptanceDatabaseIdentity(t, ctx, pool)
	store := postgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	trigger := hybridreplan.TriggerProcessor{Jobs: store}
	httpClient := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second, Transport: &http.Transport{Proxy: nil}}
	student := studentclient.Client{BaseURL: owner.URL, WriteToken: owner.Token, HTTPClient: httpClient}
	snapshotRequest := domain.HybridSnapshotRequest{Targets: official.Data.Targets, TriggerContext: domain.HybridSnapshotTrigger{Kind: official.Data.TriggerKind, Reason: "Actual T20.2 owner baseline", CorrelationID: official.EventID}}
	baseline, err := student.GetHybridPlanningSnapshot(ctx, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID, snapshotRequest)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("actual registered owner baseline: %v", err)
	}
	processor := hybridreplan.SnapshotProcessor{Jobs: store, Students: student, Clock: systemClock{}, LeaseTTL: 20 * time.Second, RetryDelay: 20 * time.Millisecond}
	connection, err := natsgo.Connect(natsURL, natsgo.Name("t202-actual-owner-proof"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual broker unavailable")
	}
	defer connection.Close()
	js, err := connection.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	// Planner consumer is offline while the actual owner relay publishes the
	// genuine postcommit fact. JetStream retains it until this consumer starts.
	relayReq, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, owner.URL+"/__t202/relay", bytes.NewBufferString("{}"))
	relayReq.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", owner.Token)
	relayReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	relayResponse, err := httpClient.Do(relayReq)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("production Student relay: %v", err)
	}
	var relayResult struct {
		Claimed   int  `json:"claimed"`
		Published bool `json:"published"`
	}
	decodeErr := json.NewDecoder(relayResponse.Body).Decode(&relayResult)
	relayResponse.Body.Close()
	if relayResponse.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || decodeErr != nil || !relayResult.Published {
		t.Fatalf("production Student outbox publication failed status=%d claimed=%d", relayResponse.StatusCode, relayResult.Claimed)
	}
	consumer, err := planningmessages.NewPlanningStateConsumer(ctx, natsURL, trigger)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { consumer.Close() }()
	t202Await(t, ctx, 5*time.Second, func() bool { return t202InboxCount(t, ctx, pool, official.EventID) == 1 })
	beforeGeneration := t202Generation(t, ctx, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID)
	current, err := student.GetHybridPlanningSnapshot(ctx, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID, snapshotRequest)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(current.Path, baseline.Path) {
		t.Fatalf("event alone changed Student path: %v", err)
	}
	t202ProcessUntilDone(t, ctx, processor, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID)
	if count := t202JobCount(t, ctx, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID); count != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("one authoritative snapshot produced %d jobs", count)
	}
	t.Log("genuine Student outbox -> actual broker -> durable Planner inbox -> actual coherent Student snapshot -> real snapshot job passed")

	// Transport fixture: repeat the identical original owner payload without a
	// publisher dedupe header so the actual consumer exercises receipt replay.
	t202Publish(t, js, official, false)
	t202Await(t, ctx, 5*time.Second, func() bool {
		info, e := js.ConsumerInfo(planningmessages.PlanningStateStream, planningmessages.HybridReplanDurable)
		return e == nil && info.NumPending == 0 && info.NumAckPending == 0
	})
	if generation := t202Generation(t, ctx, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID); generation != beforeGeneration {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate receipt created generation %d from %d", generation, beforeGeneration)
	}
	if processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(ctx); err != nil || processed {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate event created work processed=%v err=%v", processed, err)
	}

	// Named transport-burst fixtures reuse only the real owner/path/target
	// references. No new Evidence/Mastery rows or path mutations are fabricated.
	burst := make([]domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent, 5)
	for i := range burst {
		burst[i] = t202TransportFixture(official)
		t202Publish(t, js, burst[i], true)
	}
	t202Await(t, ctx, 5*time.Second, func() bool {
		for _, event := range burst {
			if t202InboxCount(t, ctx, pool, event.EventID) != 1 {
				return false
			}
		}
		return true
	})
	t202ProcessUntilDone(t, ctx, processor, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID)
	if count := t202JobCount(t, ctx, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID); count != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("burst created %d jobs for unchanged coherent state", count)
	}
	t202Await(t, ctx, 5*time.Second, func() bool {
		info, e := js.ConsumerInfo(planningmessages.PlanningStateStream, planningmessages.HybridReplanDurable)
		return e == nil && info.NumPending == 0 && info.NumAckPending == 0
	})
	consumer.Close()
	t202Await(t, ctx, 3*time.Second, func() bool {
		info, e := js.ConsumerInfo(planningmessages.PlanningStateStream, planningmessages.HybridReplanDurable)
		return e == nil && info.NumWaiting == 0
	})

	// Real delivery loss after durable ingress: receive a named transport fact,
	// commit through the actual Store, then close its broker connection without
	// ACK. The production consumer must recover and replay the immutable receipt.
	lost := t202TransportFixture(official)
	t202Publish(t, js, lost, true)
	lostConnection, err := natsgo.Connect(natsURL, natsgo.Name("t202-lost-ack-after-owner-receipt"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	lostJS, err := lostConnection.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		lostConnection.Close()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	subscription, err := lostJS.PullSubscribe(domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged, planningmessages.HybridReplanDurable, natsgo.Bind(planningmessages.PlanningStateStream, planningmessages.HybridReplanDurable), natsgo.ManualAck())
	if err != nil {
		lostConnection.Close()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	delivered, err := subscription.Fetch(1, natsgo.MaxWait(3*time.Second))
	if err != nil || len(delivered) != 1 {
		lostConnection.Close()
		t.Fatalf("actual lost-ACK delivery: %v", err)
	}
	decoded, err := planningmessages.DecodePlanningStateMessage(delivered[0])
	if err != nil || decoded.EventID != lost.EventID {
		lostConnection.Close()
		t.Fatal("lost-ACK fixture delivery mismatched")
	}
	if created, err := trigger.ReceivePlanningStateEvent(ctx, decoded); err != nil || !created {
		lostConnection.Close()
		t.Fatalf("actual pre-ACK durable commit created=%v err=%v", created, err)
	}
	lostGeneration := t202Generation(t, ctx, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID)
	manualInfo, err := js.ConsumerInfo(planningmessages.PlanningStateStream, planningmessages.HybridReplanDurable)
	if err != nil {
		lostConnection.Close()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	manualDelivery := manualInfo.Delivered.Consumer
	lostConnection.Close()
	consumer, err = planningmessages.NewPlanningStateConsumer(ctx, natsURL, trigger)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t202Await(t, ctx, 40*time.Second, func() bool {
		info, e := js.ConsumerInfo(planningmessages.PlanningStateStream, planningmessages.HybridReplanDurable)
		return e == nil && info.NumAckPending == 0 && info.NumPending == 0 && info.Delivered.Consumer > manualDelivery
	})
	if t202InboxCount(t, ctx, pool, lost.EventID) != 1 || t202Generation(t, ctx, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID) != lostGeneration {
		t.Fatal("lost ACK duplicated durable receipt/generation")
	}
	t202ProcessUntilDone(t, ctx, processor, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID)
	if count := t202JobCount(t, ctx, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID); count != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("redelivery created %d snapshot jobs", count)
	}
	t.Log("actual consumer restart/lost-ACK redelivery recovered exactly one receipt and snapshot job")

	// Actual network outage at the Student read boundary leaves durable work.
	outage := t202TransportFixture(official)
	t202Publish(t, js, outage, true)
	t202Await(t, ctx, 5*time.Second, func() bool { return t202InboxCount(t, ctx, pool, outage.EventID) == 1 })
	offline := processor
	offline.Students = studentclient.Client{BaseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:1", WriteToken: owner.Token, HTTPClient: &http.Client{Timeout: 200 * time.Millisecond}}
	if processed, err := offline.ProcessNext(ctx); !processed || !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable) {
		t.Fatalf("actual owner outage processed=%v err=%v", processed, err)
	}
	if !t202Pending(t, ctx, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID) || t202JobCount(t, ctx, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("owner outage lost queued work or created job")
	}
	restarted := processor
	t202ProcessUntilDone(t, ctx, restarted, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID)
	final, err := student.GetHybridPlanningSnapshot(ctx, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID, snapshotRequest)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(final.Path, baseline.Path) {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot-only chain mutated Student path: %v", err)
	}
	if output := os.Getenv("PLANNER_T20_SNAPSHOT_FILE"); output != "" {
		var jobRaw []byte
		if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT snapshot_json::text FROM hybrid_evaluation_job WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1`, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID).Scan(&jobRaw); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(output, jobRaw, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if output := os.Getenv("T202_PLANNER_RESULT_FILE"); output != "" {
		result := map[string]any{"official_owner_event_id": official.EventID, "registered_student_http": true, "student_production_outbox_relay": true, "actual_jetstream_consumer": true, "planner_real_postgres": true, "snapshot_jobs": t202JobCount(t, ctx, pool, owner.StudentID, owner.PathID), "path_version_before": baseline.Path.Version, "path_version_after": final.Path.Version, "duplicate_deduped": true, "burst_coalesced": true, "lost_ack_recovered": true, "owner_outage_recovered": true, "evaluation_performed": false, "path_mutations": 0, "named_transport_fixtures": []string{"five distinct burst facts using committed owner references", "one lost-ACK fact using committed owner references", "one outage fact using committed owner references", "one identical owner-envelope duplicate without publisher dedupe header"}}
		encoded, _ := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
		if err = os.WriteFile(output, encoded, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}

func t202ReadJSON(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(raw, value) != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: owner fixture unavailable")
	}
}
func t202Await(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, limit time.Duration, check func() bool) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.NewTimer(limit)
	defer deadline.Stop()
	ticker := time.NewTicker(25 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		if check() {
			return
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("actual owner proof context expired")
		case <-deadline.C:
			t.Fatal("actual owner proof condition timed out")
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
func t202InboxCount(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, id string) int {
	t.Helper()
	var count int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM hybrid_planning_state_inbox WHERE event_id=$1`, id).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return count
}
func t202JobCount(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, sid, pid string) int {
	t.Helper()
	var count int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM hybrid_evaluation_job WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2`, sid, pid).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return count
}
func t202Generation(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, sid, pid string) int64 {
	t.Helper()
	var generation int64
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT generation FROM hybrid_evaluation_work WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2`, sid, pid).Scan(&generation); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return generation
}
func t202Pending(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, sid, pid string) bool {
	t.Helper()
	var pending bool
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT generation>processed_generation FROM hybrid_evaluation_work WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2`, sid, pid).Scan(&pending); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return pending
}
func t202ProcessUntilDone(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, p hybridreplan.SnapshotProcessor, pool *pgxpool.Pool, sid, pid string) {
	t.Helper()
	t202Await(t, ctx, 10*time.Second, func() bool {
		if !t202Pending(t, ctx, pool, sid, pid) {
			return true
		}
		if _, err := p.ProcessNext(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("actual coherent snapshot checkpoint: %v", err)
		}
		return !t202Pending(t, ctx, pool, sid, pid)
	})
}
func t202TransportFixture(owner domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent) domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent {
	e := owner
	e.Data.TriggerIdentity = uuid.NewString()
	e.CausationID = e.Data.TriggerIdentity
	e.EventID = domain.PlanningStateChangedEventID(e.StudentID, e.Data.LearningPathID, e.Data.TriggerKind, e.Data.TriggerIdentity)
	e.OccurredAt = time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	return e
}
func t202Publish(t *testing.T, js natsgo.JetStreamContext, event domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent, publisherDedupe bool) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(event)
	message := natsgo.NewMsg(domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged)
	message.Data = raw
	message.Header.Set("X-Event-ID", event.EventID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Correlation-ID", event.CorrelationID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Causation-ID", event.CausationID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Schema-Version", "1")
	if publisherDedupe {
		message.Header.Set(natsgo.MsgIdHdr, event.EventID)
	}
	if _, err := js.PublishMsg(message); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("actual broker fixture publish: %v", err)
	}
}
